verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents an official Snowpark API for Python, Java, and Scala. It also publishes official OpenAPI-compliant REST API specs on GitHub, with Postman collections, so developers can build integrations in the language of their choice, alongside the SQL API and an official CLI. The probe 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the official specs are published in the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of official general-purpose client connectors/drivers (e.g., Python/JDBC/Node), SDK depth or reference docs beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.
